name: Car Playground Race! (game series, see description)
author: Toothless1
description: This was made just for fun but is still part on my game series. Go to my profile for the rest of the game series. Just like in the last Playground I made (https://connect.unity.com/mg/other/car-playground-in-neon) if I get a lot of likes/attention to this I will make a different playground. Please let me know in the comments below what colour you want and I will choose the most wanted colour. This is the latest game in the series that I have made from pre-made assets.
